epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce full stack startup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add Docker Compose configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be launched locally with one command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository without a docker-compose file
When I run docker-compose up
Then the full stack services start successfully
Given running services
When I query the health-check endpoint
Then it returns a 200 OK status
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual service initialization commands from >4 to 1.

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material modification time from manual API calls to <30 seconds via UI.
requirements: R1: Implement UI for updating and deleting existing epidemiological materials

slices.title: Implement update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete buttons, so that users can modify the material catalog directly from the frontend.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog
When the user clicks the edit button and saves changes
Then the UI sends a PUT request to the API and updates the local state
Given an existing material
When the user clicks the delete button
Then the UI sends a DELETE request and removes the item from the view
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend component missing update and delete actions bottleneck.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time spent on manual database updates from >5 minutes per edit to <10 seconds via UI.

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized data access vulnerability rate from 100% to 0%.
requirements: R1: Add authentication mechanism blocking unauthenticated users from accessing or creating materials

slices.title: Implement access control checks
slices.jtbd: When implementing security for this epic, I want to add authentication checks, so that restricted endpoints block unauthenticated access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then they receive an unauthorized error and are prompted to log in
Given an authenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then the request succeeds normally
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated request success rate on protected endpoints from 100% to 0%.
